title: Component: Rubric - Robustness
evidence: All eight visual criteria carry at least one adequate guard. Criteria 16-18, 20-23 anchor to the expected file ('consistent with the corresponding expected file' or 'matching the token appearance in the corresponding expected file'). Criterion 16 also carries guard (a) with 'read clearly against the dark background'. Criterion 19 pairs its mechanical checks ('no text clipped, truncated, or overlapping another element') with an explicit legibility guard ('legible') in the same criterion. No visual/formatting criterion can be satisfied by a degenerate shortcut such as shrinking elements to unreadable size.
